strategy_independence_rule: no evidence layer below may contain momentum, funding-factor score, cross-sectional rank, portfolio weight, future return, PnL, IC, Sharpe, or any R1 verdict

fields.name: instrument_instance_id
fields.why_required: binds evidence to one lifecycle-scoped identity, never a bare ticker
fields.raw_derivation: r1_lifecycle_contract.json:instrument_instance_id template
fields.missingness_semantics: never null

fields.name: utc_date
fields.why_required: the atomic evidence unit for all four locked hypotheses is one UTC day
fields.raw_derivation: UTC calendar date of the trade event timestamps aggregated into this record
fields.utc_event_time_semantics: calendar day boundary at 00:00:00Z inclusive to 23:59:59.999...Z inclusive
fields.missingness_semantics: a day with zero canonical trades still gets a record with trade_count=0 and close=null (see close field), never a silently absent row for a day the instance was TRADABLE

fields.name: open
fields.why_required: diagnostic/corroboration only; no locked R1 operation currently reads open
fields.raw_derivation: price of the first canonical unique trade in the UTC day by event timestamp
fields.utc_event_time_semantics: first qualifying trade by UTC event timestamp
fields.duplicate_semantics: canonical unique trades only (see trade dedup rule under trade_count)
fields.missingness_semantics: null when trade_count=0 for the day
fields.precision_semantics: preserve source string precision; never round before storage
fields.provenance: r1_source_precedence_freeze.json:daily_close (open is the symmetric first-trade analogue of the frozen last-trade close rule)

fields.name: high
fields.why_required: diagnostic/corroboration only; no locked R1 operation currently reads high
fields.raw_derivation: max(price) among canonical unique trades in the UTC day
fields.missingness_semantics: null when trade_count=0

fields.name: low
fields.why_required: diagnostic/corroboration only; no locked R1 operation currently reads low
fields.raw_derivation: min(price) among canonical unique trades in the UTC day
fields.missingness_semantics: null when trade_count=0

fields.name: close
fields.why_required: H012 momentum score and every daily-execution/gap/cost rule read close
fields.raw_derivation: last qualifying trade by UTC event timestamp, then immutable trade identity as tie-break
fields.utc_event_time_semantics: last qualifying trade strictly within the UTC day
fields.duplicate_semantics: exact duplicate trade rows (identical trade id/timestamp/price/size) collapse to one observation before ranking by event time
fields.missingness_semantics: null (never forward-filled, never synthetic) when trade_count=0; the frozen PIT rule then excludes the day from the 90/30 finite-day window
fields.precision_semantics: preserve source string precision; no float rounding on ingest

fields.name: base_volume
fields.why_required: forensic/diagnostic cross-check against quote_turnover via price*size reconciliation
fields.raw_derivation: sum(size) for canonical unique trades in the UTC day
fields.missingness_semantics: 0 when trade_count=0 (distinct from close's null -- volume of zero trades is a true zero, price of zero trades is undefined)

fields.name: quote_turnover
fields.why_required: sole PIT liquidity-eligibility input (trailing 30-day median) and breadth-gate input
fields.raw_derivation: sum(price * size) for canonical unique trades in the UTC day
fields.duplicate_semantics: canonical unique trades only; forbidden to zero-fill or merge incompatible archive fields
fields.missingness_semantics: 0 when trade_count=0; a day with quote_turnover=0 counts as a finite (non-missing) observation for the 30-day finite-volume-day rule -- only an absent/unparseable day is missing
fields.precision_semantics: computed in source-native decimal precision, not float64

fields.name: trade_count
fields.why_required: distinguishes a true zero-liquidity day from a missing/unparseable day and drives open/high/low/close null semantics
fields.raw_derivation: count of canonical unique trades retained after dedup and rejection
fields.missingness_semantics: never null; 0 is a valid, meaningful value

fields.name: first_source_timestamp_utc
consumed_by: future independent reference parser (Gap 2, not built here)
fields.raw_derivation: event timestamp of the first canonical unique trade in the UTC day
fields.missingness_semantics: null when trade_count=0
fields.precision_semantics: preserve source precision (Bybit trade archive is millisecond)

fields.name: last_source_timestamp_utc
fields.why_required: defines the daily_close event boundary and forensic reconstruction anchor
fields.raw_derivation: event timestamp of the last canonical unique trade in the UTC day
fields.missingness_semantics: null when trade_count=0

fields.name: first_source_trade_id
fields.why_required: immutable trade identity tie-break per the frozen daily_close rule; forensic reconstruction
fields.raw_derivation: trdMatchID of the first canonical unique trade
fields.duplicate_semantics: unique per trade by source contract
fields.missingness_semantics: null when trade_count=0; UNRESOLVED if a source schema variant ever lacks trdMatchID (none observed to date -- see schema registry)

fields.name: last_source_trade_id
fields.why_required: immutable trade identity tie-break for close; forensic reconstruction
fields.raw_derivation: trdMatchID of the last canonical unique trade
fields.duplicate_semantics: unique per trade by source contract
fields.missingness_semantics: null when trade_count=0

fields.name: duplicate_count
fields.why_required: information-loss accounting; lets a future auditor tell a quiet day from a filtered day
fields.raw_derivation: count of raw rows collapsed as exact duplicates before aggregation
fields.duplicate_semantics: this field IS the duplicate accounting
fields.missingness_semantics: never null; 0 is valid

fields.name: rejected_row_count
fields.why_required: information-loss accounting for parser-rejected rows (schema mismatch, malformed record)
fields.raw_derivation: count of raw rows rejected by the parser for this UTC day
fields.missingness_semantics: never null; 0 is valid

fields.name: schema_id
fields.why_required: records which known raw schema variant produced this row (e.g. the RPI-column drift)
fields.raw_derivation: matched against r1_source_schema_registry_v1.json:known_schema_variants by observed column set
fields.missingness_semantics: UNKNOWN_SCHEMA if no registry entry matches; never silently coerced to a known variant

fields.name: source_object_sha256
fields.why_required: binds this normalized day to the exact raw archive object it was derived from
fields.raw_derivation: sha256 of the retrieved raw compressed archive object (per r1_ingest_contract.json:pipeline gzip validation plus SHA-256 step)
fields.missingness_semantics: never null for a day with trade_count>0; null only when trade_count=0 and no object was retrievable

fields.name: instrument_instance_id
fields.missingness_semantics: never null

fields.name: settlement_timestamp_utc
fields.raw_derivation: settlement timestamp carried by the realized funding observation itself
fields.missingness_semantics: never inferred from current fundingInterval (forbidden per source_precedence_freeze); a settlement without its own timestamp is UNRESOLVED, not defaulted

fields.name: realized_funding_rate
fields.raw_derivation: official realized Bybit funding-history observation
fields.missingness_semantics: never predicted_funding_rate; missing means no imputed cashflow, reported as missing
fields.duplicate_semantics: non-identical duplicate settlements at the same timestamp are fail-closed (conflict_rule)

fields.name: source_query_identity
fields.raw_derivation: endpoint + symbol + segment range hash (GET /v5/market/funding/history?category=linear&symbol=<symbol>, <=60d segment)
fields.missingness_semantics: never null

fields.name: raw_response_sha256
fields.raw_derivation: sha256 of the raw API response page containing this settlement
fields.missingness_semantics: never null

fields.name: assignment_state
fields.raw_derivation: UNASSIGNED_AMBIGUOUS when the owning instrument_instance_id has identity_state=IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS
fields.missingness_semantics: never null

fields.name: gap_end_utc
fields.missingness_semantics: null means unresolved/ongoing as of cutoff

fields.name: gap_class
fields.type: enum [vendor_recording_incident, exchange_outage, illiquidity_no_trades, api_or_archive_absence, suspension, true_delisting, unknown_disappearance]
fields.missingness_semantics: fallback UNKNOWN, never silently coerced to a specific class

LifecycleEvidenceV1.grain: one record per instrument_instance_id (mutable only by append-only state transition log; the current-state row is what frozen operations consume)

fields.name: instrument_instance_id
fields.raw_derivation: venue|symbol|contract_type|first_observed_timestamp[|symbol-id=<id>]

fields.name: state
fields.type: enum [UNKNOWN, PRELAUNCH, OBSERVED_NOT_ELIGIBLE, TRADABLE, TEMPORARILY_UNOBSERVABLE, TERMINATED_VERIFIED, TERMINATED_AMBIGUOUS]

fields.name: identity_state
fields.raw_derivation: IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS when the historical-instance compiler cannot separate reuse from false-split per the minimum_identity_rule (same venue+ticker+contract_type+base+quote is one identity hypothesis; split only on affirmative discontinuity evidence)
